Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Round Ceiling Pendant Chandelier Fixture - 12 Inch Shade, 12.5 - 60.5 Inch Cord, Brushed Nickel
Colors: Brushed Nickel
Materials: Metal
This simple, sleek dome pendant has brushed nickel finish for a modern look. A white finish on the inside of the hood enhances the illumination. The base and hood can be angled to accommodate sloped ceilings over a kitchen island or bar area. 12" Diameter. Enclosed rods can adjust height from 12.5" to 60.5". Metal rods and hood with brushed-nickel finish Sleek, simple modern style that can be used on sloped ceilings 60-watt vintage bulb included Professional installation recommended. Intended for indoor use only
